said.q: The works of art in this collection were selected from the personal collection inherited by Marina Picasso, Pablo Picasso's granddaughter. After Pablo Picasso's death in 1973, his granddaughter Marina authorized the printing of these original lithographs, which have come to be known as the Picasso Estate Collection.

events.n: publication of the edition; year of the original: 1919
re-creation of a gouache and crayon of 1919; approved by the Heirs of Pablo Picasso
events.q: Limited Edition re-creation of a gouache and crayon entitled "Guitare verre et bouteille" by Pablo Picasso created in 1919.
Upon completion of the edition, the plates were defaced and destroyed by Marina Picasso.
